rationale: A unanimous Court is likely to affirm on a narrow, text-focused reading of § 3729(b)(2)(A)(ii) (post-FERA), emphasizing that E-rate reimbursement requests to USAC advance a federally created and FCC-directed program “whether or not the United States has title to the money.” Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion minimalist and fact-bound, with any separate writings most likely from textualists (e.g., Gorsuch/Thomas/Barrett) to elaborate on ordinary meaning and reject any Treasury-only gloss.
